thread:
michelle_support: FYI customer @acme_prod_ops reporting p99 spikes to ~12s + intermittent 500s during the midnight billing window. They opened a ticket, asking for timeline and mitigation.
acme_prod_ops: seeing it on our side too — spikes start around 23:58 UTC, sustained for ~8-10min. All calls to /v1/generate time out or return 500.
michelle_support: request ids they sent: req=abc123, req=abc124. sent logs + header screenshot.
kevin_oncall: looking at infra — dedicated pool for acme is at 100% GPU utilization and attach_queue jumped. probable scale-up lag + cold GPU attach slowdown.
raj_sre: can you paste the prom queries you used? also any autoscale errors in controller logs?
kevin_oncall: quick queries: ```
sum by(pool) (inflight_attaches{pool="acme-dedicated"})
max_over_time(gpu_utilization{pool="acme-dedicated"}[10m])
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
kevin_oncall: controller logs show repeated "attach request timeout" and "image pull delayed" in the 23:58-00:06 window.
olivia_eng: looks like a double problem: 1) pool at max, fairshare + attach thundering herd; 2) a couple of hosts failed to attach due to kernel image pull TTL -> cold starts. recommendation: temporary capacity bump + increase min_prewarm for priority queue.
michelle_support: customer asks for immediate mitigation while you investigate root cause. can we offer a short-term workaround?
raj_sre: mitigation plan: a) bump reserved capacity for acme by +2 GPUs (temporary) b) increase priority queue slots, c) enable fallback to hosted model variant for low-priority routes, d) roll a hotpatch to reduce image pull concurrency.
kevin_oncall: I've kicked off a capacity bump request (ticket infra#4521). deploy-bot: "autoscaler: applied override -> pool acme-dedicated +2 gpus until 2026-03-18T01:30Z"
deploy-bot: "prewarm: increased priority_min=3 for pool acme-dedicated"
acme_prod_ops: thanks — latency improving now, p99 back <2s after ~90s. will monitor.
olivia_eng: follow-ups: collect attach_latency histogram, image pull failure rate, and controller retry backoff traces. suggest changing attach backoff jitter to randomized 500ms-2s.
raj_sre: repro steps we used: ```
# simulate burst
for i in `seq 1 200`; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME" -d '{"prompt":"x"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &
done
# watch attach queue
kubectl -n infra exec -it autoscaler -- curl localhost:9090/metrics | grep attach_queue
```
michelle_support: customer updated ticket that they're satisfied with the temporary fix. I'll keep the ticket open until root cause and permanent mitigations applied.
kevin_oncall: open action items: 1) raj to triage image pull TTL and kernel image availability; 2) olivia to propose autoscaler tuning PR (backoff + priority prewarm) by EOD; 3) infra to confirm capacity bump rollback schedule. I'll keep monitoring tonight. :white_check_mark:
raj_sre: ack, starting logs + node repro now. will update in this thread.
michelle_support: thanks everyone — copying summary to the customer and setting follow-up for postmortem if we hit another window.
